items.headline: $HYPE Flips Bybit, Kraken, OKX in Open Interest
items.summary: $HYPE open interest jumped 80% in Q3, lifting Hyperliquid past Bybit, Kraken and OKX with an 11.7% share across major rivals.

items.headline: $INJ Opens Veyra Vote for Cross-Chain Trading
items.summary: $INJ governance opened the Veyra vote for a Nov. 24 upgrade adding cross-chain asset transfers and trading infrastructure; turnout is still below quorum.

items.headline: $OSMO Restarts After Halt as Upbit Pauses Transfers
items.summary: $OSMO block production resumed after a roughly four-hour halt, while Upbit kept trading open but paused deposits and withdrawals.

items.headline: $SKY Advisor Moves to Halt New Core Vault Borrowing
items.summary: A $SKY advisor proposed stopping new Core vault borrowing after BA Labs flagged 771 vaults and 376.33M $USDS in debt; repayments would continue.

items.headline: $AVAX Owns 5% of Tokenized Stocks
items.summary: Tokenized-stock venues are splitting chains, and $AVAX now holds about 5% of the sector after NYSE picked Avalanche for its planned 24/7 market.
